description: A relation points at a mention that failed validation. The MENTION's error is reported (it is real and fixable); the relation is dropped silently rather than adding a second, derivative error. Live eval: a note burned all 3 retries on a dangling relation alone, because 'fix that mention first' is unactionable when the mention was never emitted — relations are hints (§4), so one must never cost the whole note.
